want to share my sincere appreciation for W Wheatfield Surgery. I have consistently received exceptional care here, and I truly feel supported every time I visit.

A special thank you to Dr Christian Owusu, my GP, whose professionalism, kindness, and genuine care have made a real difference to my wellbeing. He is always approachable and understanding, and I feel very fortunate to be under his care.

I also want to acknowledge Dr Reha Modi, whom I recently met. She was incredibly compassionate, trustworthy, and a great listener. Her calm and thoughtful approach was very reassuring.

The reception team also deserves recognition. They are always polite, friendly, and very helpful. I especially want to mention Ms Asma, Niamh, and Jaiya. Their courtesy and efficiency consistently stand out. A memorable moment for me was when Jaiya remembered my name and date of birth without needing to ask — a small gesture that made me feel genuinely valued and respected.

Overall, Wheatfield Surgery is an outstanding practice with a dedicated and caring team. I’m truly grateful for the excellent service they provide. Highly recommended.
